text: Read-only source-audit hypothesis for the forthcoming checkpoint derivative/scale work, not a causal diagnosis or policy change: PointwiseRankOne.solveInto computes v = -scale*g/(damping + ||g||^2/(2*loss+epsilon)). Its unsmoothed magnitude is nonmonotone in gradient magnitude, peaking at ||g|| = sqrt(damping*(2*loss+epsilon)). Above that point, stronger gradients receive smaller raw updates; below it the rule is approximately scaled gradient descent. The current real-data distribution relative to this crossover has NOT been measured, and subsequent support smoothing, step clipping and acceptance can change the effect substantially. Record gradient norms, damping, crossover fractions and update alignment on actual captured states before attributing anatomy losses to this preconditioner. Also check how normalized CC weights and voxel count change these scales across pyramid levels.
